claim.text: Anyone can mint an artist's Degent from degent.club; the artist is paid 10% of the mint price on chain inside the minter's own funding transaction; the house never holds either party's keys or money
claim.measure: A signet mint of an artwork order whose funding transaction pays the artist output and the club output, whose reveal is co-signed by the policy signer, and whose block.space attestation lists the artist and edition
claim.reproduce: pnpm --filter @bsh/degent-mint test -- e2e  # artwork order to delivered with the studio fake receiving the royalty record

degent.role: this repo: mint service, studio service, mint SDK, web app

platform.role: @bsh/inscription attribution, @bsh/ledger payees and psbt method, @bsh/signer, @bsh/events AMQP

phases.name: Stabilise
phases.exit: Strict 0x81 reveals in service and web, CI runs on every push, large-reveal tests never time out.

items.title: 0x81 reveals with pre-committed parent return, user-held rescue key (ADR-0005)
Recovery bundle v2 and local rescue in the web app
CI on claude/** pushes; CODEOWNERS check passes --org DegentClub
120 s test budget for Full Block and Large Degent reveal tests

phases.name: Degent rules as code
phases.exit: Square, JPEG-recommended and size rules enforced by the SDK; vision review is Degent-specific and never approves on a skipped check.

items.title: validateContentMeta square check; recommendedContentType and formatAdvice
degent-rules.ts data + contracts/schemas/degent-rules.json agree
Degent-specific vision guidelines; skipped review => needsHuman, never approved
Review corpus fixtures: zero false approvals, every rejection has a reason
Web app shows the format advice and the five rules from the SDK data

phases.name: Artist Studio
phases.exit: An artist signs in with a wallet, proves a payout address, uploads, gets a verdict with reasons and is listed; every response validates against the contract.

items.title: Contracts: contracts/openapi/degent-studio.yaml, contracts/asyncapi/degent-studio.yaml
Sign in with Bitcoin via @bsh/identity; session with scope artist
Payout address proven by BIP-322 simple signature; legacy refused
Artworks: submit, upload, review once, gallery, content endpoint, delist, house review, feature
Royalty view and internal royalty record endpoint
Memory and SQLite stores with parity tests
ADR-0007 Open Studio
Web: artist sign-in, upload, status, gallery page

phases.name: Open mint with royalty
phases.exit: A signet mint pays the artist and the club in one funding transaction, the reveal is co-signed, the ledger receipt matches the chain, and a rescue after an outage leaves the artist paid.

items.title: @bsh/ledger: payees on line items, psbt payment method, payout records, ledger.payout events, refund race fixed
@bsh/inscription: encodeAttribution/decodeAttribution (CBOR metadata)
collection.minted gains artist, artworkId, edition, royalty (minor bump)
Pin bump to the platform commit carrying p3.1-p3.3
Contract: CreateOrderRequest.artworkId, Quote/Order royalty fields, ServiceConfig bps, new error codes, royalty.paid channel
Orders from artworkId: content from the studio, review skipped, edition reserved at quote
Funding PSBT outputs [commit, artist, club, change]; post-sign check covers scripts and values; dust raise
Worker verifies artist and club outputs by script; assigns edition; emits royalty.paid; posts to the studio
Attribution metadata in the envelope; collection.minted emitted with royalty fields
Ledger recording: order with payee line items, psbt intent, payouts, receipt
Web: gallery entry to mint, four quote lines, artist paid on Track, recovery bundle carries artworkId and edition
Signet launch with club fee and royalty live

phases.name: Provenance and certification
phases.exit: Every Studio mint resolves to an artist and edition from chain data alone, and the certificate says so.

items.title: Certify reads attribution from ord metadata, signs it, summarises artists/artworks/editions, artists endpoint (ADR-0008)
Attestation carries the royalty funding txid and vout from collection.minted
Site counts and artist pages read from the attestation

phases.name: Mainnet readiness
phases.exit: A signet game day with a forced signer failover, a bus outage and a parent re-lease leaves no stranded order and no unpaid artist.

items.title: Policy signer behind @bsh/signer (remote, HSM port); mainnet refusal lifted for the remote signer only
Parent UTXO procedure in the RUNBOOK; alert on lease changes
Durable stores by default; RabbitMQ via connectAmqpBus; artist notifications on royalty.paid
Edition caps (maxEditions), curation, appeal workflow (ADR-0010)
Security review: upload path, royalty verification, internal endpoints
Signet game day

phases.name: The world, and mainnet
phases.exit: First mainnet Studio mint with an artist paid on chain; weekly counts published from the certificate.

items.title: Site rebuild per products/degent/docs/site-spec.md: collection, gallery, comic, mint process, blog, artist pages
scribb.it MCP order tools over the ledger so agents can mint a Degent
Mainnet launch: curated first wave, then open submissions
